description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.2 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release adds JSON export and import for the switches in Hushfacebook settings. It previews changes before import, skips settings a build doesn't know, and refuses damaged or newer files without changing anything. Hushfacebook also has a new Facebook-blue icon, README hero, social preview and wordmarks.

13 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your own browser, stories and reels can be saved, and there's an AMOLED black theme if you want one.

Validation: 274 runtime tests passed locally. All 79 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 13 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background. That saves data and battery. The ads don't take up storage either.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes posts that Facebook adds to the feed, such as "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook's launcher icon. Long-press the icon to turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser, without Facebook's click tracker or the fbclid tag it adds. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags, such as mibextid, off the links you share or copy. The post or reel a link opens stays the same. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace it back to you.

release_notes:
## What's new

- Hushfacebook settings can now export the runtime feature switches to JSON and import them on this phone or another one. Import previews the changes, skips unknown names, and refuses damaged or newer files without changing anything.
- Hushfacebook now has a Facebook-blue identity with a new icon and README hero, plus light or dark wordmarks. The README also has direct install, download, patch, and support links.
- Story and reel saves only fetch from Meta's media servers over HTTPS, and a file reaches your gallery only once it's whole and really is the photo or video it claims to be. They still go through behind routers that answer DNS from a fake-IP range, as OpenClash and sing-box do.
- A save shows its progress in a notification with a Cancel button. Two saves started together no longer trip over each other.
- Hushfacebook's own text follows the phone's language (German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese or Turkish, English otherwise), and TalkBack now reads section titles as headings and each switch as a switch.
- Pause and safe mode now take out the reel Download button and the Save item on other people's stories. The settings screen says exactly what Pause turns off.
- The diagnostic report names your Facebook build and lists every patch, along with failed saves and Reels filter trouble. File names and Facebook's ids stay out of it.
- AMOLED black theme no longer breaks a screen on Facebook 580, and hooks that run before Facebook has started can't stop it from starting.
- Built with Morphe patcher 1.14.1, so this bundle needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.

## Validation

- 274 runtime tests and 79 patch tests passed locally, with both Android lint checks clean.
- All 13 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 without forced compatibility mode or manifest changes.

The `.mpp` is a Morphe patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Use Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer and keep its existing signing key when updating.
